κλισία, -ας, ή
(κλίνω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:31 A* ;]
1. a place for reclining; hence,
(a) a hut;
(b) an easy chair;
(with) a couch.
2. a company reclining: pl., Luk.9:14 (cf. FlJ, Ant., xii, 2, 12)
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
